Selling home goods online is tough when buyers cannot feel the fabric or gauge true scale. Flat photos just cannot bridge that sensory gap!

In this article from Silphium Design, we explore how WebGL viewers, tactile micro-textures, and organic lighting bring tactile presence to the browser without bogging down page speed.

Step inside the future of e-commerce showrooms:https://silphiumdesign.com/immersive-online-experiences-home-goods/
